parts.name: Pole
parts.info: An existing lamp post, sign pole or gate post, with the owner's permission.

parts.name: Pole clamps and arm
parts.info: Steel band clamps hold the box, the shield arm and the panel bracket.

parts.name: Enclosure
parts.info: IP65 box. The particle sensor breathes through a louvred vent in its bottom.

part.name: IP65 enclosure, about 160 x 120 x 90 mm, with louvred vent and cable glands

parts.name: Louvred vent
parts.info: Lets air reach the particle sensor's inlet while keeping rain out.

part.name: IP65 enclosure, about 160 x 120 x 90 mm, with louvred vent and cable glands

parts.name: Lid
parts.info: Front cover, with the status light.

part.name: IP65 enclosure, about 160 x 120 x 90 mm, with louvred vent and cable glands

parts.name: Status light (RGB LED)
parts.info: Green, amber or red for the last 24 hours of PM2.5; blinks red at dangerous heat.

part.name: RGB LED (common cathode), resistors, push button, perfboard

parts.name: PMS5003 particle sensor
parts.info: A laser and a small fan count particles in a stream of air drawn through its inlet. It sleeps between readings.

parts.name: FireBeetle 2 ESP32-E controller
parts.info: Wakes every 10 minutes, applies the corrections and sends the data.

parts.name: Solar manager and 18650 cell
parts.info: Charges the cell from the panel and supplies 5 V.

part.name: Solar Power Manager 5V (charger and 5 V supply)

parts.name: Radiation shield
parts.info: Stacked white plates shade the air sensor from sun and rain while air flows freely between them.

parts.name: SHT40 air sensor
parts.info: Measures air temperature and humidity in the middle of the shield.

parts.name: Sensor cable
parts.info: 1 m of 4-core cable from the shield to the box.

parts.name: Solar panel 5 V 6 W
parts.info: 275 x 170 mm, tilted towards the midday sun above the pole top.
